hypothesis: Removing synthetic initialization, retaining a composite peak, and directly admitting calibrated dense similarity may improve local matching; speed and leaderboard transfer are unproven.

global composite best across mining refresh
single-pass views and one row-local dense result
dense top60 and Stage2 calibrated similarity
